description: Creates draft Markdown copies of the existing pages of a site, most important pages first. Anole converts the page HTML itself; no text is supplied by the caller and no AI model is used. Skips pages that already have a copy. Stops at the plan limit of documents per site. The drafts are not public until published.

site.description: Site domain, e.g. example.com. Optional when the account has one site.

name: prepare_page_copies
title: Prepare Markdown copies of pages
